get.description: Liveness probe — returns the API version.
Paginated list of run summaries (newest-first as stored in the ledger).

post.description:
Trigger one IS run: build+validate a RunConfig, judge it, append to the ledger.

A bad config (unknown preset, reversed window, ...) surfaces as 422 from the
domain validator rather than a 500.

get.description: Cross-run comparison: per-metric delta vs baseline, ranks, sign consistency.

Pre-submit sweep estimate: ``n_configs`` (grid cardinality) + ``est_minutes``.

Grid axes are passed as comma lists, e.g. ``?box_period=40,60,80&confirm_days=1,2``
→ 3×2 = 6 configs. ``n_configs`` equals ``len(sweep.expand_grid(...))`` for the same
grid; we compute the cardinality directly (product of axis lengths) so no base
config is required just to count. ``preset`` is ignored as an axis.
Full ledger record for one run; 404 if absent.
Return the default gate's criteria (key / op / threshold / kind / label).

post.description: Judge a metrics dict against the default gate.
A/B/C metrics (total return, CAGR, drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar).

E metrics (win rate, profit factor, avg hold, Kelly fraction).

The trade records must carry the ``pnl`` (and, for avg hold, ``hold_days``)
keys; a missing key is a 400 (client sent the wrong shape) rather than a 500.

get.description: List preset names plus each preset's full parameter dict.
Return one preset's parameters; 404 if the name is unknown.
Strategy roster projected over the runs ledger (grouped by preset).
Version timeline for a strategy — runs of this preset, newest first (real projection).

Supported universe filters from ``UniverseConfig.default()`` (real config).

Markets / capital / liquidity / price thresholds + exclusion reasons are
config-driven and returned as-is. ``industries`` is data-derived (needs the
loaded universe metadata) — empty until the bundle is ingested.
Active research snapshot projected over the ledger (real).
Most-recent activity (last runs) projected over the ledger (real).
